description: Source registry for Bitcoin events ingestion. Each source has an adapter that knows how to parse it.

sources.name: Bitcoin.org Events
sources.notes: Community-maintained, GitHub issue submissions. Gold standard reference.

sources.name: BTC Inc / The Bitcoin Conference
sources.notes: Flagship series: Bitcoin Conference, Bitcoin Asia, Bitcoin Amsterdam, Bitcoin MENA.

sources.name: Bitcoin Bundesverband
sources.notes: German Bitcoin association. The page advertises iCal export, but the supplied export route returned 404 on 2026-09-16; use the event page until a working feed is confirmed.

monitoring.decision_reason: Keep as a monthly German discovery source. Upgrade to weekly only after it yields a current, unique event or a working structured feed.

sources.name: Plan ₿ Network
sources.notes: Global Bitcoin education network. Events + courses.

sources.name: Lugano's Plan B Forum
sources.notes: Official Lugano Plan B Forum page and ticketing links.

sources.name: BitDevs Network
sources.notes: Decentralised network of local Bitcoin dev meetups. Each city has own site + RSS.

sources.name: TABConf
sources.notes: Volunteer-driven technical Bitcoin conference. Current edition pages are hosted under versioned subdomains.

sources.name: BTC Events Map
sources.notes: Community map. Good for discovery, needs verification.

sources.name: Bitcoin Magazine Industry Events
sources.notes: Editorial coverage, not a structured calendar. Useful for discovery.

sources.name: Luma Crypto
sources.notes: 638 events, 38K subscribers. High noise, good coverage.

sources.name: Eventbrite Bitcoin
sources.notes: Massive reach. Mostly small local meetups and online courses.

sources.name: Francis Mars Bitcoin Events
sources.notes: Community-built Bitcoin event catalogue. Discovery evidence only until each event has an official page.

sources.name: BitcoinOnly Events
sources.notes: Bitcoin-only directory with affiliate content. Useful for discovery; dates and links require official-source verification.

sources.name: CryptoEvents Global
sources.notes: Broad crypto/Web3 directory. Retain only clearly Bitcoin-relevant candidates and verify them elsewhere.

sources.name: awesome-bitcoin-events legacy dataset
sources.notes: Read-only provenance for the original 61-record 2025 dataset. It is retained for auditability, not monitored for new events.

sources.name: Bitcoin Events South Africa
sources.notes: Official organizer site. Broad blockchain scope; Bitcoin relevance and individual event details should be reviewed.

cadence_rules.1_day: Canonical source with a structured feed, a confirmed update in the last 30 days, or an event starting within 30 days.
cadence_rules.7_days: Healthy source with at least one current, verified, unique event in the last two checks.
cadence_rules.14_days: Useful but low-volume source, or a source with no unique event in its last two checks.
cadence_rules.30_days: Stale, past-only, inaccessible, or low-yield source kept for future recovery.

monitoring.upgrade_rule: A source moves up one cadence tier only after a successful fetch produces at least one current, unique event with an official event URL.
monitoring.downgrade_rule: A source moves down one cadence tier after two consecutive no-change checks; after three, mark it dormant but retain its history.
